en-US.description: All the Tools You Need for Designing XML Schemas and Transformation Pipelines.
en-US.longDescription: Oxygen XML Developer is the premier XML development tool, focusing on XML source editing, Schema design, and XSLT editing/debugging. It offers powerful support to help you edit, transform, and debug XML-based documents, making XML development easy and effective. It also provides various other specialized editors for working with JSON, YAML, WSDL and other types of documents, providing specialized content completion, validation, helpful side views, conversion tools, and many other useful features.
en-US.name: Oxygen XML Developer

zh-CN.description: 为您提供设计 XML Schema 和转换流程所需的全部工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Oxygen XML Developer 是首屈一指的 XML 开发工具，专注于 XML 源码编辑、Schema 设计和 XSLT 编辑/调试。它提供强大 支持，助您轻松高效地编辑、转换和调试基于 XML 的文档。该工具还配备多种专业编辑器，可处理 JSON、YAML、WSDL 等各类文 档，提供智能内容补全、验证、实用侧边视图、格式转换工具等丰富功能。
